<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left">On January 30, 2026, Thomas P. Tulaney notified
Peoples Financial Services Corp. of his retirement from his roles as President of Peoples Financial Services Corp. and President and Director
of Peoples Security Bank and Trust Company, effective April 3, 2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left">On January 30, 2026, Peoples Financial Services
Corp. issued a press release announcing the retirement of Thomas P. Tulaney from his roles as President of Peoples Financial Services
Corp. and President and Director of Peoples Security Bank and Trust Company, effective April 3, 2026. A copy of the press release is attached
hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.</p>
